title: Spacing that grows with the screen

text:
You were right about V2: I had hand-written fixed sizes. V3 uses two tokens measured against the board's own width in container units, not percentages: 7 px at a phone, 17 px at 1920, 33 px at 3440, for the board's padding, the gap between cards and the padding inside a card.
The site's own --gap already works this way. The site's --pad is still a percentage today. Whether it should move to container units is a proposal I will bring with measurements, because it touches every page.
